```yaml
name: C# Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'csharp/**'
      - '.github/workflows/csharp-tests.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up .NET 10.0 SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '10.0'

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore csharp/GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln

    - name: Build solution
      run: dotnet build csharp/GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln --configuration Release

    - name: Update project files
      run: |
        sed -i 's/net6.0/net10.0/' csharp/Tests/Tests.csproj
        sed -i 's/net8.0/net10.0/' csharp/WinTestRunnerGame/WinTestRunnerGame.csproj
        sed -i 's/netcoreapp2.1/net10.0/' csharp/WindowsTestAppCSharp/WindowsTestAppCSharp.csproj

    - name: Run tests
      run: dotnet test csharp/Tests/Tests.csproj --configuration Release
```
